+  site:
+    name: Site (Astro + Starlight)
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    env:
+      CI: "true"
+    defaults:
+      run:
+        working-directory: site
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
+
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
+        with:
+          node-version: "24"
+          cache: npm
+          cache-dependency-path: site/package-lock.json
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+
+      - name: Format check (prettier)
+        run: npm run lint
+
+      - name: design/ is a frozen reference, never imported by site code
+        # See design/README.md: the mock is a gold-standard visual reference,
+        # not a dependency. This mirrors the guardrail already noted in
+        # design/README.md's "Forward pointers" section. Scoped to actual
+        # import syntax in code files, not prose links in .md/.mdx content
+        # (both index.mdx and brand.mdx legitimately link to design/ for
+        # attribution/context).
+        run: |
+          hits=$(grep -rlE "from ['\"][^'\"]*design/|import\(['\"][^'\"]*design/" \
+            --include='*.astro' --include='*.ts' --include='*.mjs' --include='*.js' src/ 2>/dev/null || true)
+          if [ -n "$hits" ]; then
+            echo "site/src code must never import from design/:"
+            echo "$hits"
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+      - name: Build
+        run: npm run build
+
+      - name: Install Playwright's Chromium
+        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+
+      - name: Visual regression (against committed baselines)
+        run: npm run test:visual

+import { defineConfig } from "astro/config";
+import starlight from "@astrojs/starlight";
+import tailwindcss from "@tailwindcss/vite";
+
+const base = process.env.CI ? "/gramaire/" : "/";
+
+export default defineConfig({
+  site: "https://wstein.github.io/gramaire/",
+  base,
+  vite: { plugins: [tailwindcss()] },
+  integrations: [
+    starlight({
+      title: "Gramaire",
+      description: "Grammars that render themselves.",
+      // SiteTitle is fully overridden with the logomark + wordmark lockup
+      // (src/components/SiteTitle.astro), so Starlight's own `logo` option
+      // goes unused here; the favicon link below is the browser-tab icon.
+      head: [
+        {
+          tag: "link",
+          attrs: {
+            rel: "icon",
+            href: `${base}favicon.svg`,
+            type: "image/svg+xml",
+          },
+        },
+      ],
+      components: {
+        SiteTitle: "./src/components/SiteTitle.astro",
+      },
+      // `gramaire` (Gramaire's production blocks) has no Shiki grammar; render
+      // it as plain monospace text — matching how GitHub shows the same fences.
+      expressiveCode: { shiki: { langAlias: { gramaire: "text" } } },
+      sidebar: [
+        { label: "Home", link: "/" },
+        { label: "Brand", link: "/brand/" },
+      ],
+      customCss: [
+        "./src/styles/tokens.css",
+        "./src/styles/starlight-bridge.css",
+        "./src/styles/tailwind-theme.css",
+      ],
+    }),
+  ],
+});

+import { defineConfig, devices } from "@playwright/test";
+
+// Visual-regression scaffold for M1 ("tokens+shell+brand"). Snapshots are
+// self-baselined against this site's own rendering, not pixel-diffed
+// against the imported mock screenshots directly — the mock's brand-book
+// screens show a different page composition (rejected wordmark
+// explorations, a denser layout) than the minimal brand page built here.
+// Treat the imported screenshots (design/gramark-site-handoff/screenshots/)
+// as the qualitative acceptance reference for manual review; this suite
+// guards against *regressions* in what's already been verified against
+// them. Extend to true mock-parity diffing once a page's composition
+// actually matches its corresponding screenshot 1:1 (tracked per-page as
+// later milestones land).
+export default defineConfig({
+  testDir: "./tests/visual",
+  fullyParallel: true,
+  forbidOnly: !!process.env.CI,
+  retries: process.env.CI ? 1 : 0,
+  reporter: [["list"]],
+  use: {
+    baseURL: process.env.CI
+      ? "http://localhost:4321/gramaire/"
+      : "http://localhost:4321/",
+    trace: "retain-on-failure",
+  },
+  expect: {
+    toHaveScreenshot: { maxDiffPixelRatio: 0.01 },
+  },
+  projects: [{ name: "chromium", use: { ...devices["Desktop Chrome"] } }],
+  webServer: {
+    command: "npm run preview",
+    url: process.env.CI
+      ? "http://localhost:4321/gramaire/"
+      : "http://localhost:4321/",
+    reuseExistingServer: !process.env.CI,
+    timeout: 60_000,
+  },
+});

+---
+// Railroad-diagram logomark, ported verbatim (geometry + transform) from the
+// gold-standard mock (design/gramark-site-handoff/GramaireMark.dc.html).
+// Theme-aware: ink follows --fg, the rule-node fill stays constant emerald
+// (--node) — except the `knockout` variant, used only on filled-emerald
+// tiles, where the ink is white and the node is transparent.
+//
+// `size` sets explicit width/height attributes rather than relying on a
+// parent-supplied class: Astro scopes <style> per source file, so a class
+// passed down to this component from a *different* .astro file's <style>
+// block never actually matches the <svg> rendered here — the size prop
+// keeps this component self-contained regardless of caller.
+interface Props {
+  knockout?: boolean;
+  size?: number | string;
+  class?: string;
+}
+const { knockout = false, size = 24, class: className } = Astro.props;
+const ink = knockout ? "#ffffff" : "var(--fg)";
+const nodeFill = knockout ? "rgba(255,255,255,0)" : "var(--node)";
+const dim = typeof size === "number" ? `${size}px` : size;
+---
+
+<svg
+  viewBox="0 0 96 96"
+  xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
+  role="img"
+  aria-label="Gramaire"
+  class={className}
+  width={dim}
+  height={dim}
+  style="display:block"
+>
+  <g
+    transform="matrix(1.3665595,0,0,1.3665595,-17.594856,-17.594856)"
+    fill="none"
+    stroke={ink}
+    stroke-width="6"
+    stroke-linecap="round"
+    stroke-linejoin="round"
+  >
+    <path d="M 18,48 H 33"></path>
+    <path d="M 63,48 C 70,48 71,31 78,31"></path>
+    <path d="M 63,48 C 70,48 71,65 78,65"></path>
+    <rect
+      x="33"
+      y="36"
+      width="30"
+      height="24"
+      rx="12"
+      fill={nodeFill}
+      stroke={ink}
+      stroke-width="6"></rect>
+  </g>
+</svg>

+---
+title: Brand
+description: Logomark, wordmark, and color system.
+---
+
+import LogomarkShowcase from "../../components/LogomarkShowcase.astro";
+import WordmarkShowcase from "../../components/WordmarkShowcase.astro";
+import ColorSwatchGrid from "../../components/ColorSwatchGrid.astro";
+import ColorSwatch from "../../components/ColorSwatch.astro";
+
+The full spec lives in [`docs/BRANDING.md`](https://github.com/wstein/gramaire/blob/feature/reimplement-site/docs/BRANDING.md).
+This page mirrors the mock's brand-book screens
+(`design/gramark-site-handoff/screenshots/12-brandbook-logo-favicon.png` and
+`13-brandbook-color-tokens.png`) using the site's real components — not
+static images.
+
+## Logomark
+
+A railroad / syntax-diagram mark: an entry track meets an emerald rule-node
+that forks into two alternatives — exactly what Gramaire turns a grammar into.
+Theme-aware ink, constant emerald node.
+
+<LogomarkShowcase />
+
+Sizes shown: 96, 48, 32, 16 px, and the white-knockout variant (used only on
+filled-emerald tiles).
+
+## Wordmark
+
+The single shared middle **m** is the brand hinge: `Gra` is ink, `ark` is
+accent, and the `m` is split down the middle via a hard-stop gradient — the
+sanctioned "02 · Split stem" treatment.
+
+<WordmarkShowcase />
+
+## Color tokens
+
+<ColorSwatchGrid>
+  <ColorSwatch name="--bg" var="bg" />
+  <ColorSwatch name="--bg-1" var="bg-1" />
+  <ColorSwatch name="--bg-2" var="bg-2" />
+  <ColorSwatch name="--bg-3" var="bg-3" />
+  <ColorSwatch name="--fg" var="fg" />
+  <ColorSwatch name="--fg-secondary" var="fg-secondary" />
+  <ColorSwatch name="--fg-muted" var="fg-muted" />
+  <ColorSwatch name="--fg-faint" var="fg-faint" />
+  <ColorSwatch name="--border" var="border" />
+  <ColorSwatch name="--border-strong" var="border-strong" />
+  <ColorSwatch name="--accent" var="accent" />
+  <ColorSwatch name="--accent-2" var="accent-2" />
+  <ColorSwatch name="--node" var="node" />
+  <ColorSwatch name="--out-bg" var="out-bg" />
+</ColorSwatchGrid>
+
+**One accent only.** Emerald always reads "valid." `--node` (`#15b879`) is the
+logomark's constant fill; the UI/text accent is the AA-contrast `--accent`
+(`#0a8f63` light / `#34d399` dark) — never use `--node` for text or controls.

+---
+title: Gramaire
+description: Grammars that render themselves.
+---
+
+Gramaire is an LR/IELR(1) parser generator whose grammars **are** Markdown — a
+`.gram.md` file renders as normal documentation on GitHub while being the
+exact input the generator reads.
+
+This is a placeholder landing page. The full marketing hero, live
+source→railroad showcase, and feature tiles (see the gold-standard mock at
+[`design/gramark-site-handoff/`](https://github.com/wstein/gramaire/tree/feature/reimplement-site/design/gramark-site-handoff))
+land in a later milestone — this page currently exists to verify the design
+tokens and Starlight shell render correctly.
+
+See the [brand book](/brand/) for the logomark, wordmark, and color system.
